parameters.apprise_url_plus: evolutions://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.apikey_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.host_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.instance_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-evolution` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Evolution API destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional Evolution API destinations bound per enrollment.

Deploy Evolution API on your own server (the project recommends Docker), open its dashboard, create a new instance, and link it by scanning the QR code with the WhatsApp mobile app — the instance status changes to 'open' once connected. Set your server's address as EVOLUTION_HOST, the instance name as EVOLUTION_INSTANCE, and the API key shown on that instance's settings page as EVOLUTION_APIKEY. Set EVOLUTION_TARGETS to the recipient WhatsApp number(s) in international format with no leading +, e.g. 5511999999999.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Evolution API destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Evolution API apikey

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Evolution API host

instance_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Evolution API instance

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Evolution API targets
